body.statement: Along the retained even tail \(n\ge N_0\), every treated- and control-arm empirical mean entering def:observable-envelope-inputs differs from its finite-population counterpart by \(o_{\Pr}(1)\) at \(T_n\). Consequently, \(\widehat b_n-b_n\to_{\Pr}0\) and \(\widehat u_n-u_n\to_{\Pr}0\).
body.justification: Adaptive first entry selects the terminal arms through the whole covariate path, so fixed-draw laws of large numbers cannot simply be conditioned on acceptance.
body.gap: Li and Ding establish armwise regression quantities under uniform rerandomization; the stopped nonuniform PSRR design has no published uniform path law.
body.consumer: The result makes all projection and variance inputs in the proposed interval computable from the realized experiment.
